Retail outlets and warehouses \u{2014} each has a real street address and phone number (the exact same mechanism already used for customers and providers), a city (locations in the same city can transfer stock between each other), and the real physical capacity of the space. Retail outlets track both shelving (bottles) and floor area (cartons), and, separately, real cold storage (sparkling wine, some beer) \u{2014} genuinely smaller, distinct real estate, not a subdivision of the same shelf space, with its own real total. A warehouse deals in full cartons only.
